title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Settling a Duplicate Mileage Recovery Against Recent Instant Cashouts
content:
On Cartwise Shopper Batches, the amount remaining to be taken back for a duplicate mileage posting — what is left of the later mileage posting's full amount once any goodwill applied to it has been subtracted, never below zero — is taken back by the duplicate cash-out method, which reads the shopper's payout account in Cartwise Shopper Payouts:

1. When the payout account paid out an **instant cashout less than one whole calendar month before the handling date** and the account is on an **Everyday Pay Card** plan (Blue, Gold, Platinum or Diamond), the remaining amount is **halved and rounded down to the cent**.
2. When such an instant cashout was paid and the account is on **any other payout plan**, the remaining amount is **multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to the cent**.
3. When no such instant cashout was paid, the remaining amount is taken back **in full**.

## Input — judgement — output

| Instant cashout paid less than one whole calendar month before the handling date | Payout plan | Amount taken back |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Everyday Pay Card plan | Half, rounded down to the cent |
| Yes | Weekly Direct Deposit, Instant Cashout or any other non-card plan | Three quarters, rounded up to the cent |
| No | Any | The full remaining amount |

The instant cashouts are those shown among the payout account's own entries.

## Worked figures (hypothetical remaining amount of 3.85)

- Everyday Pay Card Gold, instant cashout paid nine days ago: 3.85 halved is 1.925, rounded down to 1.92.
- Instant Cashout plan, instant cashout paid nine days ago: 3.85 multiplied by 0.75 is 2.8875, rounded up to 2.89.
- Any plan, last instant cashout paid three months ago: 3.85 in full.
